note: Toddler-friendly events near Sauvie Island, St. Johns, Portland, Vancouver and the coast, soonest first. Several holiday dates come from guides or listings rather than the organizers, so check before going.

events.title: Curiosity Kids at OMSI
events.detail: Hands-on 9 to 10 am Saturday sessions for ages 3 to 5 with family, including same-day museum admission: Become a Nature Detective (Nov 21), Design and Discover (Nov 7, Nov 28) and Sasquatch Science Team (Nov 14). Up to 20 people per class.

events.title: Fall Discount Days at the Oregon Zoo
Veterans Day at the Oregon Zoo
events.detail: Free admission for military members, veterans and their families, 9:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.

events.title: ZooLights Sensory-Friendly Night
events.detail: A calmer ZooLights evening for families with different sensory processing needs, 4:30 to 8:30 p.m.

events.title: ZooLights
events.detail: Wildlife-themed holiday light displays; tickets are sold for specific dates. Go early in the evening with little ones.

events.title: U-cut Christmas trees at Sauvie Island Farms
events.detail: The farm's blog lists u-cut trees Nov 21 to Dec 24, 9 am to 5 pm, self-serve on the honor system; all trees $60, paid by Venmo or cash.

events.title: Vancouver Community Tree Lighting
events.detail: Free Rotary Club tree lighting; Explore Washington State reports Friday, Nov 27, 2026, with the Christmas Ships escorting Santa's tugboat to the waterfront. Time not yet confirmed by the organizer.

events.title: Winter Wonderland drive-through lights
events.detail: Drive-through holiday light show benefiting Sunshine Division; Travel Portland lists Nov 27 to Dec 31, 2026, with hours that vary by day. Easy for a toddler since you stay in the car.

events.title: Seaside Turn On The Town
events.detail: Holiday season kickoff party listed for 3 to 5 pm, with Santa lighting the town; this date comes from a third-party listing, not the Seaside Chamber.

events.title: Christmas Ships Parade
events.detail: Lighted boat parades on both rivers; Carnifest reports Dec 3 to 20, 2026. Nightly routes are on christmasships.org, and parades can be cancelled for weather.
